notes: Added required stories for MAINT-DIST-UX covering contract, UI rendering, integration, and testing.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for distance display
Added core UI rendering logic story

stories.title: Define Distance Display Schema and Rendering Contract
stories.description: Define how distance is represented in provider result messages, including units (miles), formatting (e.g., '5.2 mi'), and optional presence when distance is unavailable.

stories.title: Implement Distance Rendering in MessageBubble
stories.description: Extend MessageBubble component to display distance alongside provider results, ensuring consistent placement and styling within chat responses.

stories.title: Integrate Distance Data from Backend into Chat UI
stories.description: Update frontend data handling to consume distance values returned from backend provider search and ensure they are passed into MessageBubble for rendering.

stories.title: Add Unit and UI Tests for Distance Display
stories.description: Create tests validating correct rendering of distance values, formatting, and handling of missing distance data in provider results.
